dependencies.expectedValue: Six existing families, ten distinct marketing grades, twelve core grade/battery/drivetrain/seat records. Four expanded package/roof children are non-additive: KONA Premium N Line, IONIQ5N Vision Roof, IONIQ6N sunroof and no-sunroof. Do not add 12+4 and call it 16 vehicles; the two N core records are grade-level bases for their roof children. Paint/interior/dealer stock VINs never create additional grades. Older INSTER Extended Range New stock is an epoch-held availability lead, not a current August configuration.
